title: Meta Ads for Pet-Care | Pawfectly Digital

facts.fact: Meta Ads lets businesses advertise across Facebook, Instagram, and other eligible Meta placements.
facts.quote: Meta Ads allows businesses to advertise across Facebook, Instagram, and other eligible Meta placements.

facts.fact: Businesses can set daily or lifetime campaign budgets for Meta Ads and monitor advertising results.
facts.quote: Businesses can set daily or lifetime campaign budgets and monitor advertising results.

facts.fact: The page states that Meta Ads costs depend on audience competition, campaign objectives, placements, and creative performance; it gives no specific price or cost figure.
facts.quote: Meta Ads costs depend on audience competition, campaign objectives, placements, and creative performance.

facts.fact: The page advises starting with a manageable Meta Ads budget and evaluating qualified inquiries before increasing spending; it gives no specific budget amount.
facts.quote: Start with a manageable budget and evaluate qualified inquiries before increasing spending.

facts.fact: The article was published on 1 November 2026 as an educational guide by the Pawfectly Digital Editorial Team.
The page says Meta Ads formats include photo, video, and carousel ads.
facts.quote: Photo, video, and carousel ads can highlight facilities, services, and customer experiences.

facts.fact: According to the page, Google Search Ads reach people actively searching for services, while Meta Ads introduce a business to audiences browsing Facebook and Instagram.
facts.quote: Google Search Ads can reach people actively searching for services, while Meta Ads can introduce your business to audiences browsing Facebook and Instagram.

facts.fact: The page states that advertising results vary and that advertising does not guarantee bookings.
facts.quote: Results vary, and advertising does not guarantee bookings.

facts.fact: The page states that results reported in the third-party case studies it links belong to their publishers and are not Pawfectly Digital results or guaranteed outcomes.
facts.quote: any results reported belong to their publishers and are not Pawfectly Digital results or guaranteed outcomes
